## `dockerComposeFile` {#dockercomposefile}

The name of the docker-compose file(s) used to start the services.

**Type**: `string | array`

**Default**: `[]`

## `service` {#service}

The service you want to work on. This is considered the primary container for your dev
environment which your editor will connect to.

**Type**: `string`

## `runServices` {#runservices}

An array of services that should be started and stopped.

**Type**: `array`

## `workspaceFolder` {#workspacefolder}

The path of the workspace folder inside the container. This is typically the target path of
a volume mount in the docker-compose.yml.

**Type**: `string`

## `shutdownAction` {#shutdownaction}

Action to take when the user disconnects from the primary container in their editor. The
default is to stop all of the compose containers.

**Type**: `string`

**Values**: `"none"`, `"stopCompose"`

**Default**: `"stopCompose"`

## `overrideCommand` {#overridecommand}

Whether to overwrite the command specified in the image. The default is false.

**Type**: `boolean`

**Default**: `false`

## `$schema` {#schema}

The JSON schema of the devcontainer.json file.

**Type**: `string`

## `name` {#name}

A name for the dev container which can be displayed to the user.

**Type**: `string`

## `features` {#features}

Features to add to the dev container. Ignored by devconcurrent.

**Type**: `object`

## `overrideFeatureInstallOrder` {#overridefeatureinstallorder}

Array consisting of the Feature id (without the semantic version) of Features in the order
the user wants them to be installed. Ignored by devconcurrent.

**Type**: `array`

**Default**: `[]`

## `secrets` {#secrets}

Recommended secrets for this dev container. Ignored by devconcurrent.

**Type**: `object`

## `forwardPorts` {#forwardports}

Ports that can be forwarded from the host to the container.

**Type**: `array`

**Default**: `[]`

## `updateRemoteUserUID` {#updateremoteuseruid}

Controls whether on Linux the container's user should be updated with the local user's UID
and GID. On by default when opening from a local folder.

**Type**: `boolean`

## `containerEnv.<name>` {#containerenv}

Container environment variables.

**Type**: `string`

## `containerUser` {#containeruser}

The user the container will be started with. The default is the user on the Docker image.

**Type**: `string`

## `mounts` {#mounts}

Mounts to setup on container create.

**Type**: `array`

**Default**: `[]`

## `init` {#init}

Passes the --init flag when creating the dev container.

**Type**: `boolean`

## `privileged` {#privileged}

Passes the --privileged flag when creating the dev container.

**Type**: `boolean`

## `capAdd` {#capadd}

Passes docker capabilities to include when creating the dev container.

**Type**: `array`

**Default**: `[]`

## `securityOpt` {#securityopt}

Passes docker security options to include when creating the dev container.

**Type**: `array`

**Default**: `[]`

## `remoteEnv.<name>` {#remoteenv}

Remote environment variables to set for processes spawned in the
container including lifecycle scripts and any remote editor/IDE server
process.

**Type**: `string`

## `remoteUser` {#remoteuser}

The username to use for spawning processes in the container including
lifecycle scripts and any remote editor/IDE server process. The default
is the same user as the container.

**Type**: `string`

## `initializeCommand` {#initializecommand}

A command to run locally (i.e Your host machine, cloud VM) before anything else. This
command is run before "onCreateCommand".

**Type**: `string | array | object`

## `onCreateCommand` {#oncreatecommand}

A command to run when creating the container. This command is run after "initializeCommand"
and before "updateContentCommand".

**Type**: `string | array | object`

## `updateContentCommand` {#updatecontentcommand}

A command to run when creating the container and rerun when the workspace content was
updated while creating the container. This command is run after "onCreateCommand" and before
"postCreateCommand".

**Type**: `string | array | object`

## `postCreateCommand` {#postcreatecommand}

A command to run after creating the container. This command is run after
"updateContentCommand" and before "postStartCommand".

**Type**: `string | array | object`

## `postStartCommand` {#poststartcommand}

A command to run after starting the container. This command is run after "postCreateCommand"
and before "postAttachCommand".

**Type**: `string | array | object`

## `postAttachCommand` {#postattachcommand}

A command to run when attaching to the container. This command is run after
"postStartCommand".

**Type**: `string | array | object`

## `waitFor` {#waitfor}

The user command to wait for before continuing execution in the background while the UI is
starting up.

**Type**: `string`

**Values**: `"initializeCommand"`, `"onCreateCommand"`, `"updateContentCommand"`, `"postCreateCommand"`, `"postStartCommand"`

**Default**: `"updateContentCommand"`

## `userEnvProbe` {#userenvprobe}

User environment probe to run.

**Type**: `string`

**Values**:

- `"none"` — Do not probe the user's shell for environment variables.
- `"loginShell"` — Probe with a login shell (`-lc`).
- `"loginInteractiveShell"` — Probe with a login, interactive shell (`-lic`).
- `"interactiveShell"` — Probe with an interactive shell (`-ic`).

**Default**: `"loginInteractiveShell"`

## `hostRequirements` {#hostrequirements}

Host hardware requirements.

**Type**: `object`

### `hostRequirements.cpus` {#hostrequirements-cpus}

Number of required CPUs.

**Type**: `integer`

**Default**: `1`

### `hostRequirements.memory` {#hostrequirements-memory}

Amount of required RAM in bytes. Supports units tb, gb, mb and kb.

**Type**: `string`

### `hostRequirements.storage` {#hostrequirements-storage}

Amount of required disk space in bytes. Supports units tb, gb, mb and kb.

**Type**: `string`

### `hostRequirements.gpu` {#hostrequirements-gpu}

**Type**: `boolean | string | object`

**Default**: `false`

## `customizations` {#customizations}

Tool-specific configuration. Each tool should use a JSON object subproperty with a unique
name to group its customizations.

**Type**: `object`

### `customizations.devconcurrent` {#customizations-devconcurrent}

**Type**: `object`

#### `customizations.devconcurrent.worktreeFolder` {#customizations-devconcurrent-worktreefolder}

The directory where devconcurrent will place worktrees.

**Type**: `string`

#### `customizations.devconcurrent.mountGit` {#customizations-devconcurrent-mountgit}

Whether to mount the project's git directory into each workspace's devcontainer.

Git worktrees have a simple `.git` file that points to the actual `.git` directory. If that
directory isn't available, then no git commands will work. By mounting it at its original
path in the devcontainer, `git` should just work, both inside and out of the container.

**Type**: `boolean`

**Default**: `true`

#### `customizations.devconcurrent.proxy` {#customizations-devconcurrent-proxy}

Configure DNS hostnames and HTTP proxy.

**Type**: `object`

##### `customizations.devconcurrent.proxy.enable` {#customizations-devconcurrent-proxy-enable}

Enable the devconcurrent DNS and HTTP proxy for this project.

**Type**: `boolean`

**Default**: `false`

##### `customizations.devconcurrent.proxy.hostname` {#customizations-devconcurrent-proxy-hostname}

Handlebars template for the proxied hostname, used by every service
that does not set its own.

Available variables:
- `root` (bool) — whether this is the root workspace
- `project` — project name
- `workspace` — workspace name
- `service` — name of the service from compose

**Type**: `string`

**Default**: `"{{workspace}}.{{service}}.test"`

##### `customizations.devconcurrent.proxy.services.<name>` {#customizations-devconcurrent-proxy-services}

Configure proxy settings for each docker compose service.

**Type**: `object`

###### `customizations.devconcurrent.proxy.services.<name>.hostname` {#customizations-devconcurrent-proxy-services-hostname}

Handlebars template for this service's hostname. Overrides the
project-level `hostname`.

**Type**: `string`

###### `customizations.devconcurrent.proxy.services.<name>.containerPort` {#customizations-devconcurrent-proxy-services-containerport}

If set, devconcurrent will run an HTTP proxy on ports 80 and 443 to this port in your
container, performing TLS termination on 443.

If this service runs a web service, put its port here.

**Type**: `integer`

#### `customizations.devconcurrent.env.<name>` {#customizations-devconcurrent-env}

Define shell variables

These are rendered by `dc show env` or automatically set if `shell.exportEnv` is true.

The values are given by handlebars templates with the following:
  * The `hostname` helper gives the hostname for a service.
  * The following variables are populated: `project`, `workspace`, and `root`.

**Type**: `string`

Example:

```json
{
  "BASE_URL": "{{ hostname 'app' }}",
  "DATABASE_URL": "postgres://postgres:postgres@{{hostname 'postgres'}}:5432/db"
}
```
